sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 5; Internal Quality Checks row 5; Deterministic Checks including check-runtime-contract-strings.py)
evidence: The frozen manifest records input_sha256 5da6c5087a3e9ebcbf148f1812ebc608c333956e0667f2c1563b6bacd71baf4b, matching this assignment, and the inspected workbook hash 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f matches manifest.json. The core runtime contract is stated and agrees with the verifier: instruction.md:3 names /assets/seed_data.json and the six /instructions notes, instruction.md:5 requires /app, /, and no sign-in; environment/instructions/integration.md:3 states node /app/server.js, an arbitrary working directory, 0.0.0.0:3000, /, and GET /api/health; integration.md:7-9 states independent-context sharing, restart durability, SQLite, /app/app.db, and absolute DB_PATH override. tests/test.sh:48,97-111 consumes those same health, entry, port and DB_PATH facts. policy.md:3 and overview.md:3 make the no-account shared-workspace model explicit. No seed field or graded criterion depends on a calendar date/current time, so a fixed clock is not applicable; the five-second execution budget is explicitly stated in behaviour.md:5. The functional, render, constraints, and visual criteria otherwise trace to public behavior in behaviour.md:3-9, security.md:3-5, overview.md:3-5, and ui.md:3-17. However, tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 grades all offered controls as keyboard reachable and specifically requires leaving the custom editor through an ordinary Escape/Tab path. The public UI contract only says to label controls and show keyboard focus (environment/instructions/ui.md:17), while ui.md:7 assigns Tab and Shift+Tab to indentation; no instruction states that Escape exits the editor or that this exact focus convention is required. REVIEW_POLICY.md's no-hidden-requirements guidance expressly calls out keyboard escape conventions. Conforming-alternative probe: an editor can implement every stated editing, focus-display, Run, Save, history, and persistence behavior, keep Escape inert (or use F6/Ctrl+M to leave the editor), and still be failed by cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus. Broken-app probe: a static/client-only shell cannot pass the authored Run gate (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23) or the independent-context server-save gate (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:32), so no separate weak-app false pass was identified. The assigned raw-evidence-index.json is absent (manifest review_contract.evidence_index is also empty), and this source-contract defect does not require a runtime run to demonstrate.
counterexample: A submission uses a custom SVG editor, implements required Tab/Shift+Tab block indentation, visibly shows focus whenever controls are clicked, and satisfies every stated product behavior, but keeps Escape inside the editor and uses F6 to move focus to the toolbar. It conforms to the public notes yet fails the judge's mandatory 'ordinary Escape/Tab path' leg.
suggested_fix: Either state the required keyboard focus traversal and Escape/Tab exit behavior in ui.md, or remove the Escape/Tab-path mandate from cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus and grade only the publicly required visible focus and clear controls.
